retrievalProfile.description: A tight, intimate close-up portrait featuring warm golden-sepia lighting and elegant script typography overlaid on a subtle filigree background.
triggerTerms: golden hour studio lighting R&B style

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact close-up portrait of a subject with a soulful expression, characterized by a monochromatic warm golden-brown palette, soft directional lighting that emphasizes facial contours, and a textured knit garment pulled toward the face. The composition is balanced by elegant, flowing script typography in the upper right quadrant, set against a background of faint, swirling line art.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight crop on the face creating direct intimacy with the viewer
Harmonious monochromatic palette of ochre, bronze, and deep brown
Contrast between the soft skin texture and the coarse knit of the sweater
Integration of flowing script lines with the abstract filigree background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in an extreme close-up, tilted slightly.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the highlight on the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the hands clutching the collar, then sweeps up to the script text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the upper right corner, filled with decorative filigree to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm bronze and ochre tones for skin highlights and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown for shadows and the knit sweater.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary text stroke.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows to create depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Formal cursive script with high-ascenders and decorative flourishes.
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a nib pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature oversized, circular loops
Lowercase 'y' and 'g' have elongated, sweeping tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script paired with abstract background patterns.
graphicDevices: Soft glow effect on text edges

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal, high-flourish elegance of the lettering.
Matches the sophisticated, traditional cursive feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up studio portrait of a woman with soulful eyes, wearing a dark brown knit turtleneck pulled up to her chin. Apply a warm sepia/golden-hour color grade. The background should be a soft-focus brown with faint, elegant swirling line art patterns.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, elegant script lettering in the top right corner using a golden gradient fill and a thin dark brown outline. Ensure the flourishes of the letters interact naturally with the background swirls.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and monochromatic?
Is the framing a tight close-up?
Does the script have elegant, long swashes?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific brand logos

avoid: Jagged vector lines in the script

postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony across the sepia spectrum
Ensure text legibility against the filigree
Verify the intimacy of the eye contact
Confirm the knit texture looks tactile
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up Portrait + Warm Sepia Grade + Filigree Background + Elegant Script Overlay
